issues.description: The problem statement shows the state-preparation function name with a leading underscore (_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit) while both the template and the provided solution define and use construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (without the underscore). This name mismatch is structural and can confuse students about which function to implement or what tests will import/expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across all artifacts. Either (a) change the problem statement to refer to construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (no leading underscore), or (b) change the template and solution to provide and document _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit as the expected name (or add a thin wrapper with the underscored name that delegates to construct_zero_state_prep_circuit). Prefer updating the problem statement to remove the leading underscore so it matches the template and solution.
